wger-fe0c2a17-fad9-4235-8786-84bb1de9353.description: Use an incline chest-press station and adjust the seat so the handles align with your upper chest. Keep your back against the pad and feet braced. Press the handles forward and upward along the guided path without shrugging or bouncing. Return slowly to a comfortable stretch and keep the stack or lever controlled between repetitions.

references.title: Life Fitness strength equipment

wger-ffdb4806-d64e-474b-8ce5-8df9a57fb9c.description: Set the safety stops for your intended depth, place your shoulders beneath the pads and brace against the back support. Plant your feet securely on the platform and release the start catch. Bend your knees and hips along the machine's arc while keeping your feet in contact with the platform. Push evenly through your feet to stand without snapping your knees straight. Re-engage the catch before leaving the machine.

references.title: Life Fitness strength equipment

wger-e9f3446f-ca98-4bf2-817c-0dacd123cec.description: Fit the loading belt around your hips and connect it securely to the machine's attachment. Stand on the platform with feet comfortably apart and use the support handles as needed. Release the start catch, brace and bend your knees and hips into a controlled squat. Keep the belt centered and your feet planted as you stand. Secure the load on its catch before disconnecting the belt.

references.title: Life Fitness strength equipment

wger-ce21d3a2-cdc5-410c-9970-c25029ca376.description: Set your upper back against the machine's pad and secure its hip belt or padded restraint as instructed on the station. Plant your feet so your shins approach vertical at the top. Brace, drive through your feet and extend your hips until your trunk and thighs align without arching your lower back. Lower the lever slowly and repeat. Secure the start catch before releasing the restraint.

references.title: Life Fitness strength equipment

wger-8bc4c616-e76b-4291-9074-186ecbbb3cf.name: Assisted machine pull-up
wger-8bc4c616-e76b-4291-9074-186ecbbb3cf.description: Select enough counterweight to keep each repetition controlled. Hold the overhand pull-up handles and place your knees or feet on the assistance platform as the station requires. Brace and pull your elbows down, bringing your chin toward handle height without swinging. Lower smoothly to a comfortable extended-arm position. Keep the platform controlled as you step off.
wger-8bc4c616-e76b-4291-9074-186ecbbb3cf.measurementNotes: Log repetitions with zero added load. Assistance and counterweight are not lifted kilograms; record their machine setting in your session notes.

references.title: Hammer Strength assist dip/chin station

wger-3dd0db1c-450a-46d1-ad46-d7854bdc26e.name: Assisted machine triceps dip
wger-3dd0db1c-450a-46d1-ad46-d7854bdc26e.description: Choose sufficient assistance and hold the dip handles securely. Place your knees or feet on the platform according to the machine's setup. With shoulders controlled, bend your elbows to lower through a comfortable range, keeping them near your sides. Press the handles down to extend your arms without jerking or shrugging. Control the platform throughout and step off carefully.
wger-3dd0db1c-450a-46d1-ad46-d7854bdc26e.measurementNotes: Log repetitions with zero added load. Assistance and counterweight are not lifted kilograms; record their machine setting in your session notes.

references.title: Hammer Strength assist dip/chin station

wger-12a80404-8684-4ff0-a473-d80b4ad8cd5.name: Roman-chair dumbbell hip hinge
wger-12a80404-8684-4ff0-a473-d80b4ad8cd5.description: Use a stable roman-chair or back-extension station with your feet planted on its footplate and your ankles secured beneath the supports. Position the thigh pad below the hip crease so your hips can hinge freely. Start without added weight to check the setup; when controlled, hold a light dumbbell close to your chest. Keep your spine neutral and bend at the hips through a comfortable range. Squeeze your glutes to return until your trunk lines up with your legs, stopping before you arch your lower back. Keep your feet secured throughout and lower the weight before stepping out.

references.title: Free Exercise DB: secured-foot back-extension setup

wger-d015a276-02ad-4c28-9d36-aedfbb431f5.name: Standing bent-knee hip raise
wger-d015a276-02ad-4c28-9d36-aedfbb431f5.description: Stand upright and balance on one leg. Keep your trunk steady while lifting the other leg and bending that hip and knee. Lower the foot under control, repeat, then change sides.

references.title: wger standing balance exercise

db-band-hip-adductions.name: Standing band hip abduction
db-band-hip-adductions.description: Anchor a resistance band to a sturdy low post. Stand side-on and place the loop around the ankle farther from the anchor. Use the hand nearer the post for balance and keep your torso steady. With the working knee comfortably straight, move that leg outward away from the anchor against the band. Return the foot slowly toward the standing leg without losing balance, then repeat on the other side.

references.title: Free Exercise DB band hip movement reference

wger-a94c635d-096c-45a8-a68c-64941d0b6ba.name: Supine crossed-leg rotation stretch
wger-a94c635d-096c-45a8-a68c-64941d0b6ba.description: Lie on your back. Bend your right knee and bring that leg across the left leg. Extend your left arm out at shoulder height. Use your right hand to guide the bent knee gently toward the floor on your left while keeping your left shoulder down. Breathe comfortably, hold the stretch, and repeat on the other side.

references.title: wger supine rotation stretch

wger-eaa7927e-6ea0-4fd5-bbcd-525fe90a184.name: Neutral-grip chest pulldown
wger-eaa7927e-6ea0-4fd5-bbcd-525fe90a184.description: Position yourself at the cable pulldown with your feet supported on the floor. Take the handle with your palms facing each other, about shoulder width apart. Keep your torso steady and pull the handle toward your upper chest. Pause briefly, then allow the handle to rise under control as your arms straighten.

references.title: wger neutral-grip pulldown

wger-a4f78033-90d7-45a2-96fa-509b41281ea.name: Hip-out and hip-in lateral steps
wger-a4f78033-90d7-45a2-96fa-509b41281ea.description: Stand with your feet comfortably apart and your knees soft. Keep your trunk steady as you step one foot out to the side while the other leg supports your balance. Bring the stepping foot back toward the centre under control. Repeat on both sides without crossing your feet or raising the knee into a marching motion.

references.title: wger lateral hip steps

wger-81dd44b3-67b3-4198-9e57-c2a80b3c410.name: Single-arm high-cable pulldown
wger-81dd44b3-67b3-4198-9e57-c2a80b3c410.description: Sit on the floor at a high cable pulley and hold its single grip in one hand. Begin with the working arm reaching toward the pulley so the lat is stretched. Pull the grip downward by bending the elbow, then return with control to the stretched position. Repeat on the other side.

references.title: wger exercise 1637

wger-671568f9-6653-4e11-ac71-3f34c74329a.name: Standing biceps stretch right
wger-671568f9-6653-4e11-ac71-3f34c74329a.description: Stand beside a wall with your right arm extended. Place your right hand against the wall, keep the shoulder relaxed and gently turn your torso to the left until you feel a comfortable stretch along the right upper arm. Avoid forcing the shoulder or wrist. Hold while breathing steadily, then release slowly.

references.title: wger exercise 1233

wger-346634cf-3896-4c10-bd66-28fb69d0257.name: Medicine-ball V-up
wger-346634cf-3896-4c10-bd66-28fb69d0257.description: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hold a medicine ball in both hands above and behind your head. Lift your legs and upper body together, bringing the ball toward your feet to form a V. Lower your legs and torso with control and repeat.

references.title: wger exercise 976

wger-148f2ffc-05e2-486b-874f-2a401337a1c.name: Chest-supported low-cable rope row
wger-148f2ffc-05e2-486b-874f-2a401337a1c.description: Position an incline bench facing a low cable pulley fitted with a rope. Stand with your feet stable and lean your chest into the upper bench pad. Hold the rope ends with your palms facing each other and reach toward the pulley. Draw your elbows back toward your sides to bring the rope toward your lower chest. Return slowly while keeping your chest supported and your trunk steady.

references.title: wger rope pullover/row setup and source illustration

wger-d561c00c-436d-47d9-b647-222e7b637ab.name: Half-kneeling thoracic rotation
wger-d561c00c-436d-47d9-b647-222e7b637ab.description: Kneel on a mat with your right knee down and your left foot flat in front of you, both knees bent about ninety degrees. Keep your pelvis facing forward and your ribs stacked over your hips. Extend both arms forward at shoulder height with your palms together. Keep the left arm pointing forward and slowly open the right arm to the side as you rotate through your upper back. Follow the moving hand with your eyes without leaning backward or shifting your hips. Return the palms together with control, then switch the kneeling position and rotate to the other side.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-7870ad8d-a0c1-4e3a-a4fe-a237908eba9.name: Seated machine abdominal crunch
wger-7870ad8d-a0c1-4e3a-a4fe-a237908eba9.description: Choose a seated abdominal-crunch machine and adjust its seat and pads according to the station instructions. Sit with your hips fully supported, place both feet on the foot supports or floor as the machine requires, and grasp the provided handles. Set a light resistance before beginning. Keeping your pelvis on the seat, exhale and bring your ribs toward your pelvis by gently rounding your trunk against the resistance. Keep your neck relaxed and avoid pulling with your arms or driving with your legs. Return slowly to the upright starting position without letting the resistance snap back. Repeat within a comfortable range.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-caccd791-ff30-452a-816e-790edadb78c.name: Single-leg glute bridge
wger-caccd791-ff30-452a-816e-790edadb78c.description: Lie on your back on a mat with your arms by your sides and your right foot flat on the floor, close enough that its knee is bent. Lift the left foot and keep that knee bent toward your chest. Brace your abdomen and press through the right foot to lift your hips until your shoulders, hips and right knee form a straight line. Keep both sides of your pelvis level and avoid arching your lower back. Pause briefly, then lower your hips to the mat with control. Complete the repetitions and switch legs.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-4c317795-c301-4081-9f96-6036682f80c.name: Band pull-apart drill
wger-4c317795-c301-4081-9f96-6036682f80c.description: Stand upright with your feet about hip width apart and hold a light resistance band in both hands at shoulder height. Place your hands far enough apart that the band has mild tension, with your palms facing downward and elbows slightly bent. Keep your ribs down and shoulders away from your ears. Move your hands outward until the band approaches your upper chest, drawing your shoulder blades gently together. Keep the elbows at the same small bend rather than turning the movement into a row. Return slowly to the starting width and repeat without snapping the band.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

db-bent-over-two-arm-long-bar-row.name: Two-hand landmine row
db-bent-over-two-arm-long-bar-row.description: Secure one end of a barbell in a landmine attachment and load the free end with suitable plates. Straddle the bar facing its loaded end and place a double-D row handle around the shaft immediately behind the plates. Grip both sides of the handle, bend your knees slightly and hinge your hips back while keeping your spine neutral. Begin with both arms extended and the weight clear of the floor. Pull the handle toward your upper abdomen, keeping your elbows close to your body and your torso still. Pause, then lower with control until both arms are extended again. Keep both hands on the handle throughout.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-abdd2b41-0c30-4ec1-8d14-f6dc5deb356.name: Seated bent-knee hamstring stretch
wger-abdd2b41-0c30-4ec1-8d14-f6dc5deb356.description: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair with your left foot flat on the floor. Extend your right leg forward, resting its heel on the floor, and keep a small bend in the right knee. Point the toes upward without forcing the ankle. Lengthen your spine and hinge forward from your hips, placing your hands lightly on your thighs for support. Stop when you feel a gentle stretch behind the right thigh; do not push the knee straight or round your back to reach farther. Breathe normally during the hold, return upright and repeat on the opposite side.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-4b23738a-67a8-41af-996d-abc53a7c3f9.name: Incline dumbbell press
wger-4b23738a-67a8-41af-996d-abc53a7c3f9.description: Set a sturdy adjustable bench to a low incline of about thirty degrees. Sit with a dumbbell in each hand, then lie back with your head and upper back supported and both feet flat on the floor. Bring the dumbbells beside your upper chest with wrists stacked over elbows and elbows angled moderately away from your torso. Press both weights upward over your upper chest without lifting your hips or shrugging your shoulders. Pause with your arms extended but comfortable, then lower slowly to the starting position. Keep your wrists straight and choose a load you can control throughout.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-4925b6c0-bbe6-4864-a649-23ec18d4998.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
wger-4925b6c0-bbe6-4864-a649-23ec18d4998.description: Stand or sit upright with your spine comfortable and your shoulders relaxed. Raise your right arm in front of you and bring it across your chest at about shoulder height. Use your left hand or forearm to support the right upper arm just above the elbow, rather than pressing directly on the joint. Gently draw the arm closer to your chest until you feel a mild stretch at the back of the right shoulder. Keep the shoulder down and avoid twisting your torso to increase the range. Breathe steadily during the hold, release slowly and repeat with the other arm.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-00eae665-ff78-4373-9c43-f44a4a1b43e.name: Frog stand balance
wger-00eae665-ff78-4373-9c43-f44a4a1b43e.description: Squat on a mat and place both palms on the floor about shoulder width apart, fingers spread. Bend your elbows and rest the inside of each knee against the corresponding upper arm near the elbow. Keep your knees bent and look slightly ahead of your hands. Shift your weight forward gradually until one foot becomes light, then lift it a small distance. If stable, lift the other foot so both feet hover while your palms support you and your knees remain on your arms. Hold briefly with control, then place both feet back on the mat. Keep the lift low and stop before losing balance.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-5edf07a8-cca2-4199-96a5-9988369be98.name: Chest-supported kettlebell row
wger-5edf07a8-cca2-4199-96a5-9988369be98.description: Set a sturdy adjustable bench to a low incline of about thirty degrees. Lie face down with your chest supported on the pad, your head beyond its upper edge and both feet firmly on the floor. Hold one kettlebell in each hand below your shoulders, with enough clearance that the weights do not hit the floor or bench frame. Keep your neck aligned with your spine and your chest against the pad. Bend both elbows and draw the kettlebells toward your lower ribs without shrugging or lifting your torso. Pause briefly, then lower slowly until your arms are extended. Choose weights that allow steady movement.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-ca514fad-c6ce-47b0-93a0-dc73a350709.name: Standing band hamstring curl
wger-ca514fad-c6ce-47b0-93a0-dc73a350709.description: Anchor a resistance band low to a secure fixed point and fasten the other end to your right ankle using an appropriate ankle cuff. Stand facing the anchor with light band tension and hold a stable support for balance. Keep your knees close together, hips facing forward and torso upright. Bend the right knee to bring your heel toward your buttock while keeping the right thigh nearly vertical. Stop before your hips move or your lower back arches. Slowly straighten the knee until the foot returns near the floor. Repeat with controlled tension, then switch the cuff to the other ankle.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-77c98954-b50d-46f0-9912-3981f856d5a.name: Seated close-grip cable row
wger-77c98954-b50d-46f0-9912-3981f856d5a.description: Sit at a low-cable rowing station with both feet on its footplates and a close neutral-grip handle attached. Keep your knees slightly bent and hold the handle with both hands. Sit tall with a neutral spine and begin with your arms extended in front of you. Draw the handle toward your upper abdomen, keeping your elbows near your sides and your shoulders away from your ears. Pause briefly as your shoulder blades move together, without leaning backward or jerking your torso. Extend your arms slowly to return the handle, keeping your feet and hips in place. Repeat with a manageable load.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-d27a93fa-7066-477c-a475-c6b6170831d.name: Single-arm high-cable triceps extension
wger-d27a93fa-7066-477c-a475-c6b6170831d.description: Attach a single-grip handle to a high cable pulley and select a light resistance. Stand facing away from the machine with one foot forward for balance. Hold the handle in your right hand and bring the right upper arm beside your head, with your elbow bent and the handle behind your head. Keep your ribs down, back neutral and upper arm steady. Straighten the right elbow to move your hand forward and upward, resisting the cable without moving your shoulder or torso. Bend the elbow slowly to return the handle behind your head. Complete the repetitions, then switch arms.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-33a55e1a-ff83-4c34-b056-887a121b097.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
wger-33a55e1a-ff83-4c34-b056-887a121b097.description: Kneel on a mat with your right knee on the floor and your left foot planted in front of you. Keep the left knee above the ankle and place your hands on your hips. Gently tuck your pelvis by bringing your belt line upward and squeeze the right buttock. Keeping your torso upright, shift your hips a small distance forward until you feel a comfortable stretch at the front of the right hip. Avoid arching your lower back or lunging deeply. Breathe normally during the hold, move back to release the stretch and switch the kneeling legs.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-df18b577-0610-4804-a993-161024da67d.name: Prone W raise
wger-df18b577-0610-4804-a993-161024da67d.description: Lie face down on a mat with your legs extended and your forehead resting lightly on a folded towel. Bend both elbows about ninety degrees and position your arms in a W shape, with your upper arms angled away from your torso and your hands beside your head. Keep your abdomen gently braced and your chest close to the mat. Draw your shoulder blades together and lift your hands and elbows a small distance from the floor, keeping the W shape. Pause briefly without lifting your chin or arching your lower back, then lower both arms with control. Repeat slowly.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context

wger-36a309ba-7dd1-43c9-9efc-788c7cd9fbd.name: Wall-supported standing march
wger-36a309ba-7dd1-43c9-9efc-788c7cd9fbd.description: Stand facing a wall about an arm length away and place both palms against it at shoulder height. Keep your torso upright, feet hip width apart and shoulders relaxed. Shift your weight onto your left foot and raise your right knee forward toward hip height, keeping the right ankle beneath the knee and the pelvis level. Use the wall lightly for balance rather than hanging your weight through your arms. Pause briefly, then lower the right foot to the floor with control. Raise the left knee in the same way and continue alternating. Avoid bouncing, leaning backward or twisting your hips.

references.title: ACE Exercise Library — general exercise context
